title: A Survey on Zero Pronoun Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing zero pronoun translation datasets to identify the overrepresentation of specific pro-drop languages (e.g., Chinese and Japanese) and the lack of resources for other pro-drop languages.

Evaluating the distribution of text genres in existing datasets to identify an overrepresentation of single domains (such as news) that may not capture the rich zero pronoun phenomena found in informal genres like dialogues.
Analyzing machine translation outputs to identify gender errors and stereotypes that occur when models fail to correctly identify the antecedent of a zero pronoun.
